articles.title: United Breweries Q1 results: Profit declines 9.6% to ₹166.3 crore
articles.description: Beer maker United Breweries Ltd on Tuesday reported a 9.64 per cent decline in its consolidated net profit to Rs 166.28 crore in the June quarter of FY'27 due to higher expenses and West Asia conflict hitting its margins. The company, controlled by Dutch multinational brewing company Heineken NV, had posted a net profit of Rs 184.03 crore in the April-June quarter a year ago, United Breweries Ltd (UBL) said in a regulatory filing. However, UBL's revenue from operations was up 10 per cent to Rs 5,919.44 crore in the June quarter of FY27. It was at Rs 5,380.78 crore in the corresponding period a year ago. The growth was led by the beer category, which continued double-digit growth, said UBL in its earnings statement. "UBL sell-in volumes were up 9%, and sell-out volumes were up 13% in Q1 FY27, while deliberately reducing inventory levels (-20%) to improve cash flow," it said. Its net sales grew over 7 per cent, driven by volume growth, price increases and favourable geographic mix .

articles.title: China's 'Iron Brotherhood' Hits A Paywall: Pakistan's J-10CE, J-35A Jet Deals Face CPEC Debt Squeeze
articles.description: China calls Pakistan its "iron brother", but does that friendship end where unpaid bills begin? In this episode, we examine explosive claims made by prominent Pakistani journalist Aftab Iqbal that Beijing is delaying J-10CE fighter jet spare parts and holding back the J-35A stealth fighter because of Pakistan's mounting CPEC debt. While neither China nor Pakistan has officially confirmed these allegations, the claims have reignited questions over Islamabad's growing dependence on Chinese military hardware and financing. We also analyse Pakistan's worsening debt crisis, the unresolved financial disputes surrounding CPEC, China's leverage over Pakistan's defence ecosystem and what this means for the Pakistan Air Force. Could unpaid infrastructure loans now affect military cooperation? Is Pakistan's dependence on Chinese weapons becoming a strategic vulnerability? Watch this detailed analysis as we separate verified facts from unverified claims and examine the bigger geopolitical picture.
